'''''Padawan Training''''' was the name of a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It depicted a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] named [[Asotost Lemme]] wielding a [[Color/Legends|purple]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] against a dangerous beast resembling the [[Sher Kar/Legends|Sher Kar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. The story behind the painting suggested that Lemme, in search of his lost friend, stumbled upon the lair, forcing him to put his [[Jedi training/Legends|Padawan training]] to use, lest he suffer the same fate as those who failed before him.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Padawan Training'' was a painting in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

This was one of three paintings offered to players during the launch of Game Update 16. The painting was created from art created by an actual player named Asotost Lemme of ''Shadowfire''.
